# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps

HOURS = parse_span("09:00-17:00")


def spans(*texts):
    return [parse_span(text) for text in texts]


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_midday_gap(self):
        worked = spans("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00")
        want = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, HOURS), want)

    def test_edges_and_overlap(self):
        worked = spans("10:00-12:00", "11:00-16:00")
        want = ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
                "gap 16:00-17:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, HOURS), want)

    def test_nobody_worked(self):
        want = ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps([], HOURS), want)

    def test_full_coverage(self):
        worked = spans("09:00-17:00")
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, HOURS), [])

    def test_outside_opening_hours(self):
        worked = spans("08:00-10:00")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps(worked, HOURS)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# owner: platform
from typing import List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def _free_spans(merged, hours):
    edges = [hours.start]
    for span in merged:
        edges += [span.start, span.end]
    edges.append(hours.end)
    pairs = zip(edges[0::2], edges[1::2])
    return [Span(*pair) for pair in pairs
            if pair[0] < pair[1]]


def _check_inside(worked, hours):
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < hours.start or hours.end < span.end:
            raise ValueError(f"outside hours: {span}")


# ---
def find_gaps(worked, hours) -> List[str]:
    """Label each stretch of opening hours nobody covers."""
    worked = list(worked)
    _check_inside(worked, hours)
    free = _free_spans(merge_spans(worked), hours)
    return [f"gap {format_span(item)} ({item.minutes} min)"
            for item in free]
